pickerDesc.zh: 用 Claude 风格的模型菜单替换宿主的菜单。默认也会接管推理等级滑块，第三方推理强度插件的滑块将不生效；关掉下面的「推理等级滑块」可把座位交还宿主。
pickerDesc.en: Replaces the host's model menu with a Claude-style one. It also takes over the reasoning-effort slider by default, so a third-party effort plugin's slider will not show; turn off "Reasoning effort slider" below to hand the seat back to the host.

modelDescriptionsDesc.zh: 一级列表里每个模型名下面写一行说明。
modelDescriptionsDesc.en: A line under each model in the picker's first level.
